item.title: Contact Us
item.description: Please direct all your inquiries to:Department of Political Science Central European University Quellenstraße 51, 1100 WienOffice A-404Email: polsci{at}ceu{dot}eduPlease fill out the online form below to send us any questions, comments, or suggestions you might have. We will do our best to get back to you as soon as possible. If you do not receive a reply within three business days, please contact departmental staff as technical glitches might have prevented your message from reaching us.

item.title: Arete: Undergraduate Essay Competition
item.description: The Political Science Department at Central European University invites students to its second Undergraduate Essay Competition.Prizes1. The winning essay(s) will be published on the departmental website2. The best submissions will receive signed certificates of excellence from the CEU Political Science Department. 3.
